title: Rejoice, the Lord Is King
description: Rejoice, the Lord Is King in Tonic Solfa to DARWALL: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses, and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley’s words were first published in John Wesley’s Moral and Sacred Poems in 1744. John Darwall wrote the tune in 1770.
underlay: Re-joice, the Lord is King! Your Lord and King a-dore; Re-joice, give thanks, and sing, And tri-umph ev-er-more; Lift up your heart, lift up your voice; Re-joice, a-gain I say, re-joice!

lines: Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
The God of truth and love;
When He had purged our stains
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
He rules o’er earth and Heav’n,
The keys of death and hell
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
We soon shall hear th’ archangel’s voice;
The trump of God shall sound, rejoice!
